messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT 3180001111 — High websocket/streaming timeouts observed for tenant 'novacorp' on VPC Gateway (eu-west-1). Error rate spike 5m P50->P95 streaming timeouts. Paging oncall.
Emma (oncall): I'm on it. grabbing logs and checking health dashboards.
Raj (sre): I'm here too, starting root route checks. Do we know if this is only streaming (ws) or also regular REST?
Lina (support): Customer reported degraded live updates in their UI ~09:12 UTC. They called support and we opened the ticket.
Mike (customer-eng): Confirmed on call with NovaCorp — they said retries are spiking and client starts reconnect loops. No recent config changes on their side, but they did a canary deploy of their appgw proxy ~09:05 UTC.
Emma (oncall): Good context. Sophia, can runtime confirm whether connection queues are backing up on the tenant isolation layer?
Sophia (eng-runtime): Looking at the tenant metrics: novacorp queue length for streaming workers jumped 8x at 09:10. Per-tenant CPU for dedicated-v2 pool is under 70%, but the accept loop shows many aborted handshakes. Possible upstream appgw is sending FINs.
Raj (sre): Capture of gateway logs (snippet):
```
[09:11:02] ws_accept: tenant=novacorp conn=xxxx handshake_error: unexpected EOF
[09:11:47] stream_handler: tenant=novacorp write_timeout after 5s
[09:12:03] retry_loop: tenant=novacorp client_reconnects=120
```
Emma (oncall): That handshake_error matches the customer's described behavior. Could be client-side EOF or middlebox. Mike, can you ask NovaCorp to paste their proxy logs for 09:00-09:20 UTC?
Mike (customer-eng): On it — looped in their infra lead. They said they'll paste logs in ~10m.
Jordan (platform): Quick check: autoscaler didn't scale the dedicated pool because request concurrency per-host stayed high but not breaching CPU threshold. We might need to temporarily relax the scaling policy for novacorp.
Sophia (eng-runtime): We have a soft mitigation: route new stream connections for novacorp to an alternate dedicated pool (dedicated-v3-ephemeral) which has spare capacity and slightly different TLS settings. I can prepare the override.
Emma (oncall): Do we have a quick rollback if that makes things worse?
Sophia (eng-runtime): Yes — it's an API route override. Command to run:
```bash
redwood admin route-override --tenant=novacorp --target-pool=dedicated-v3-ephemeral --ttl=15m --reason="incident 3180001111 live mitigation"
```
Raj (sre): Before switching, can we also try reducing websocket handshake timeout on ingress from 5s -> 2s to fail fast and avoid queued sockets? That's a lower-risk change.
Jordan (platform): I can push the config flag to the ingress layer: `ingress.ws.handshake_timeout=2s` for novacorp via feature flag. Will take ~2-3m to propagate.
Emma (oncall): Let's do handshake timeout reduction immediately, then if errors persist, do the route-override. Sophia — prep the override but don't apply yet. Raj — collect post-change metrics. Lina keep NovaCorp PM updated. Mike, ask them to temporarily pause client-side reconnect storms (increase backoff) if possible.
Mike (customer-eng): Messaged them — they agreed to throttle reconnects by adding randomized backoff for 30min.
deploy-bot: deploy starting: platform-config/ingress-ws-timeout -> canary (3 hosts) by Jordan.
Jordan (platform): Can confirm canary rollout started. Monitoring healthchecks.
Emma (oncall): Post-change checks?
Sophia (eng-runtime): Initial metrics: handshake errors down 40% within 90s of canary, queue length trending down. P95 latency for streaming acceptance improved.
Raj (sre): Still seeing intermittent write_timeouts around 09:16-09:17 on a subset of connections. Could be client aborts after timeout reduction.
Emma (oncall): Decision time: do we escalate to route-override or keep tightening client-side backoff + monitor? What's the customer tolerance?
Mike (customer-eng): NovaCorp says they'd rather avoid switching pools if possible, but they want service stable — they'll accept the override if we recommend it.
Sophia (eng-runtime): Given improvement but lingering timeouts, I'll prepare the route-override and a quick rollback plan. If we route, we should also enable our streaming-fallback to SSE for new connections as a graceful fallback.
Emma (oncall): Ok go ahead with override in 5m unless Raj objects. Raj?
Raj (sre): Ack. I'll stand by and watch error rates and open tcpdump on one affected host. If error rate worsens, we rollback immediately.
Sophia (eng-runtime): Executing override now:
```bash
# apply override (dry-run validated)
redwood admin route-override --tenant=novacorp --target-pool=dedicated-v3-ephemeral --ttl=30m --reason="live mitigation incident 3180001111" --approve
```
Sophia (eng-runtime): Override applied. Traffic starting to shift.
incident-bot: NOTE: routing policy change detected for tenant 'novacorp' (novacorp -> dedicated-v3-ephemeral). Audit ID a1b2c3.
Mike (customer-eng): NovaCorp infra confirms they see fewer reconnects now. Observed client success rate increased from 72% -> 94% for new sessions.
Raj (sre): tcpdump shows client aborts stopped after routing, and server write_timeouts dropped to near baseline. No CPU pressure on new pool.
Emma (oncall): Great. I'll update the incident ticket and start drafting a post-incident action list. Lina please draft an external summary for NovaCorp with timeline and recommended client-side backoff changes.
Lina (support): Drafting now, will post to the ticket for review.
Jordan (platform): I'll keep the ingress timeout change in canary for another 15m then promote if stable.
Sophia (eng-runtime): Scheduling a follow-up check in 30m to determine permanent routing or config changes.
Emma (oncall): Handing off monitoring to Raj for the next hour — I'm heading offline in 20m. Raj, you'll own the pager. :raised_hands:
Raj (sre): Taking it. Pager on me.
Emma (oncall): Thanks team. Closing live mitigation; incident remains active for RCA and customer comms.
Mike (customer-eng): NovaCorp PM asked for a postmortem with remediation suggestions (rate limiting + HTTP fallback). I'll coordinate.
Emma (oncall): Good. Marking this thread as incident-live-mitigation-complete for now. :white_check_mark:
